w2:textbox.label:
1. Run this example standalone.
2. Navigate to any web page.
3. Copy the address of the browser running this standalone example and paste it into the address bar of the browser running the arbitrary web page.
4. Click the setSrc() button.
5. Check the IFrame's internal screen changes.
6. Click the browser's back button.
7. Check the previous IFrame screen is displayed. (spaReplaceHistory=“false”)
8. Confirm that clicking the browser's back button again returns to the previous arbitrary web page.
(Also verify the spaReplaceHistory="true" example.)
